title: Concept: Apache Flink dashboard is reachable without authentication
description: The Flink dashboard names every task manager host and the jobs that run on them, and its REST endpoint is the same port. That combination lets the caller read the cluster layout and submit a job to it.
applicability: Responses from a Flink cluster that serves the dashboard on a reachable interface.
risk: The caller maps the cluster hosts and can submit a job that runs their code on a task manager.
